text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At last, it's time for the Shuka Sho—the G1 race that concludes the Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Who do you think will win this time around? I've got a feeling it's gonna be Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I heard she trained like mad over the summer. I can't wait to see her race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The crowd is more than excited to watch the showdown play out. Meanwhile, over in the waiting room…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Narita Brian won a sweeping victory in the Japanese Derby. Is the Kikuka Sho as good as hers?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha! Man, they sure have a lot to say!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But they've got a point! She'll probably smash another record! Haha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …Actually, knowing her, she totally will do it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm all fired up! I'll give her a run for her money! I'm gonna go warm up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she grabs her bag, an envelope falls out of it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm? The heck is this? …A letter?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Let's see what it has to say…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "We can't wait to see you absolutely crush this race. Go and take 'em all down!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "We packed your favorite licorice into the envelope too. The whole dorm's cheering for you!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: …Sheesh. When'd they slip this into my bag?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes a piece of licorice from the envelope and pops it into her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mm, that's good. It tastes just like home.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Everyone's gonna be watching—can't forget that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The curtain finally rises on the final leg of the Triple Tiara—the Shuka Sho!
